notes: Sauron mission conditions corrected from owner-authoritative text: His Dark Throne = 3 active plots; To Find Them All = Ringwraiths in play OR 6 influence on The Shire; In Darkness Bind Them/Where the Shadows Lie/To Rule Them All = red/black/yellow marker at stage III (order-matched to the owner's list).
Shire influence is approximated by region influence (eriador-and-enedwaith) since influence is tracked per region, not per location.

heroMissions.name: Noble Blood
heroMissions.text: The heroes win if they collectively have 1 or less Corruption cards.

heroMissions.name: Against The Shadow
heroMissions.text: The heroes win if there are no more than 2 monster tokens in play.

heroMissions.name: Isildur's Secret
heroMissions.text: The heroes win if they collectively have at least 5 favor.

heroMissions.name: Minas Morgul Kept At Bay
heroMissions.text: The heroes win if there are 2 or less minions in play.

heroMissions.name: The Spear of the West
heroMissions.text: The heroes win if each hero has completed both his Starting and Advanced quest.

sauronMissions.name: To Find Them All
sauronMissions.text: Sauron wins if he has either the Ringwraiths in play or 6 influence on The Shire.

sauronMissions.name: His Dark Throne
sauronMissions.text: Sauron wins if there are 3 active Plot cards in play.

sauronMissions.name: In Darkness Bind Them
sauronMissions.text: Sauron wins if his red story marker has advanced to stage III of the Story Track.

sauronMissions.name: To Rule Them All
sauronMissions.text: Sauron wins if his yellow story marker has advanced to stage III of the Story Track.

sauronMissions.name: Where the Shadows Lie
sauronMissions.text: Sauron wins if his black story marker has advanced to stage III of the Story Track.
